results.title: Daisy Chain
results.overview: After an international tragedy, a group of friends makes a last-ditch effort to preserve their legacy. But when things don’t go as planned, everyone scrambles to stay alive the best way they know how.

results.title: UNKRNS: Smart Angels Inc.
results.overview: Set in the futuristic ruins of +Colonia, Latin America’s first ‘smart city’ currently under construction, UNKRNS: SMART ANGELS INC. tells the love story of an angel investor and a unicorn startup: two mythological creatures that have resurfaced as figures of technocratic entrepreneurship. Blending video game engine worlds with live-action scenes across intertwined timelines, the film explores recurring cycles of power and technological desire while imagining new narratives for digital infrastructures from the South.
In today’s world, messages get misunderstood. Transmission is interrupted.

results.title: don't relax yet ;)
results.overview: don’t relax yet ;) implodes the codes of guided relaxation and fitness, through a glitch aesthetic as grating as it is cathartic. The overworked body is plunged into a state of forced hypnosis, and injunctions of beauty, willpower and performance are repeated to the point of absurdity

results.title: Maryse
results.overview: Between the solitude of the training room and the immensity of the sea, Maryse, a former bodybuilding champion, performs her routine once more. In the quest for a body pushed to its limits, she reveals her relationship to femininity, appearances, and bodybuilding as a form of self-sculpting.

results.title: Chill Jill
results.overview: A nonchalant clown explores the surreal landscape they were spawned into, a landscape created through the fabric of the digital, one that exists in the world of an American sitcom. As they find themselves falling asleep, it appears they have re-spawned into a new, yet familiar landscape in which they are eager to explore with a curious and positive mindset. They face grotesque obstacles in this nightmare that they register as fun moments that continue the plot due to their aloof nature. This is until they ultimately encounter death and meet with their God, Flumbus who is ready to give them a new life.

results.title: The Game
results.overview: Converted into a non-human character the protagonist enters a digital space. A territory that is being constantly reshaped and avatars imposed upon the players. Using video game imagery, the film examines the similarities between events in the Balkan corridor and the logic of video game worlds. It explores how certain groups are perceived through virtual environments and dangerous analogies.

results.title: dream*time*travel (out of capitalism)
results.overview: dream*time*travel (out of capitalism) lingers between a guided meditation, a (dream*)time travel and the prothesis of the self in the digital sphere. It questions self care procedures in western societies and how these are affected and emptied due to the ruling capitalist system. The body floats in the digital space, slowly degrading as well as the imagined (and real) woods.

results.title: Stephen Teague
results.overview: A box shows up at a man’s door. What happens next is shocking. INSTANTLY REGRETS IT!

results.title: Ayat in the Open
results.overview: When a group of young Black Muslims from South Los Angeles trade the city for the mountains, they experience for themselves something their community has always known, that the wilderness belongs to them too.

results.title: A Moment
results.overview: About benches as silent witnesses to our encounters, separations and the passage of time. As people arrive and leave, the bench becomes a central point around which bodies, relationships and time change. What remains of us after we stand up and walk away except for the trace that we were once there?

results.title: Dioscuri
results.overview: A guy from the provinces searches for his place between the old world and marginal freedom but rejected by both faces a decisive choice.

results.title: Tras La Pantalla
results.overview: Jorge, a frustrated writer, finds a cell phone and decides to keep it. He begins receiving messages from Amanda, an actress who has just returned to the city and believes she is talking to her ex-partner, the phones owner. Driven by a desire for connection, Jorge replies and begins to assume someone elses identity.

results.title: Eye Love Cinema
results.overview: A small, movie-loving, monstrous eye is born from a satanic ritual, a short vignette about love and birth, regardless of who or what you are.

results.title: Soy Luna Tour: The last show
results.original_title: Soy Luna Tour: El último show
results.overview: After ten years, the cast of Soy Luna returns to the stage with a live show featuring the series’ most iconic songs and tracks from the new season. Music, dance, and emotion come together in a celebration created to reconnect with fans.

results.title: Purple Lingerie
results.overview: A single mother raising her child alone encounters a piece of purple lingerie that awakens her long-suppressed desire for intimacy, leading her to reclaim an identity beyond motherhood.
